history.summary: plan.md completed (pre-settled; 15 phases: JPU template, HTP/KubeCoder/FieldnotesApp, ZigbeeControl as D1's proving app then DHCPApp/ElectronicsInventory/IoTSupport, the scaffold, then the template and directory removals, D3's deletion procedure, and the Terraform-pin references in AnsibleSpecs, Ansible and ArgoCDTools), with P1–P8 pushing and proving green builds in-phase per D1 and the settled order; verification.json has 12 criteria, V11 owed to the operator's registry deletion. Committed as AnsibleSpecs 549b9e3; the dry-run parses but P4–P9's Targets resolve only after the operator's kc env restart (close-out A1).

Two things need the operator: the four apps' Jenkinsfile and suite runner are now generated by ModernAppTemplate's root template, which no phase touches and which isn't on GitHub (Q1), and D1 brings back the setup the Playwright image was built to fix after validation hangs, with no ruling on that history (Q2); one advisory on executors pushing inside phases before review.

Rulings Q1, Q2 and A1 applied and citations re-grounded on today's origin/main. ModernAppTemplate joins as P5, a root-template release that ZigbeeControl (P6, D1's proof), DHCPApp, ElectronicsInventory and IoTSupport take with copier update. The scaffold phase is dropped because ModernAppFrontendTemplate lost its validation pipeline in 032f366. P1–P9 push after their own gate. verification.json gains V13 for Q1. Committed as AnsibleSpecs bdc6def; the dry-run parses, and P4–P9's Targets resolve only after the environment restart (close-out A1).
